fact: Elephants and manatees are both Afrotherians, a group that evolved in Africa, while rhinos belong to Perissodactyla.
Crocodiles are archosaurs, making them more closely related to birds like chickens than to lizards or snakes.
Hippos are the closest living relatives of whales and dolphins, having diverged after ruminants like cows branched off.
Lungfish belong to the lobe-finned fishes, placing them genealogically closer to terrestrial tetrapods like cows than to ray-finned fish like salmon.
Animals and fungi share the evolutionary clade Opisthokonta, diverging more recently from each other than either did from green plants.
Rabbits and rodents form the clade Glires, while hedgehogs belong to the distantly related Laurasiatherian lineage.
Despite both being flightless, penguins are modern Neognath birds closely allied with flying birds like eagles, rather than with ancient ratites like ostriches.
Giraffes and cetaceans are even-toed ungulates inside Artiodactyla, whereas horses belong to the odd-toed ungulates.
Tuna and humans both possess internal bony skeletons as osteichthyans, while cartilaginous sharks branched off before bone evolved.
Starfish and humans are deuterostomes sharing an embryonic blastopore pattern, whereas octopuses are protostomes.
